authority_boundary: Exact visible text is preserved for grounding; all other fields are research annotations and are not source wording.
claim_relevant_visible_text: The Company started mass production of HBM3E 8H this month and plans to mass produce HBM3E 12H products and a 128GB product based on 1b nanometer (nm) 32Gb DDR5 within the second quarter.
precision_guard: HBM3E 8H mass production is reported as started during April 2024. HBM3E 12H remains a Q2 production plan in this sentence. Neither statement by itself proves shipment to a named accelerator platform or completion of customer qualification.
researcher_paraphrase: Samsung reported HBM3E 8H mass production had started in April 2024 and planned HBM3E 12H mass production within Q2.
source_title: Samsung Electronics Announces First Quarter 2024 Results
